environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function processes IoT device messages from any caller without authentication. Lambda execution role has AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess and CloudWatchLogsFullAccess. No resource policy restrictions on the Function URL. VPC: not configured (public Lambda). The /tmp filesystem in Lambda is writable and supports symlink creation. No input validation middleware or API Gateway in front.
